# PresetForge 2.0 release package

`PresetForge-v2.0.0.rbxm` is the customer-ready Roblox Studio plugin model built from the production sources in this release.

## Install locally

1. Open a blank place in Roblox Studio and show **View > Explorer**.
2. Right-click `Workspace` and choose **Insert from File...**.
3. Select `PresetForge-v2.0.0.rbxm`.
4. Right-click the inserted `PresetForge` model and choose **Save as Local Plugin**.
5. Delete the temporary model without saving the blank place.
6. Open PresetForge from the **Plugins** toolbar. Restart Studio if the button is not immediately visible.

## Verified contents

The model contains one `Main` Script and sixteen production ModuleScripts under `Modules`. XML inspection found no Studio tests, QA fixtures, local filesystem paths, or project data. Two independent Rojo 7.7.0 builds were byte-identical.
